under1.headline: You're 1 Year Away From 482 Eligibility
under1.intro: You don't qualify for a 482 visa yet, and any agency that suggests otherwise is misleading you. The good news: one year of genuine, verifiable Australian work experience changes everything.
under1.honestNote: This is a longer path, but it's the right one. We would rather tell you this now and build your case properly than take your money for a visa you won't receive.

one3.intro: With 1–3 years of relevant experience and the right occupation, you are eligible for a 482 TSS visa via employer sponsorship. RedBridge will match you to a verified employer and manage the pathway to 186 PR.

three.headline: 3+ Years? You May Qualify for Direct 186 Entry
three.intro: With 3+ years of recent experience in an eligible occupation, you may not need to spend time on a 482 first. The 186 Direct Entry (DE) stream can get you to permanent residency faster, if your skills assessment and employer are both in place.
three.honestNote: Not all experienced candidates qualify for 186 DE directly. Your skills assessment result and occupation code matter significantly. We confirm at your free consultation.

requirements.label: 3 years full-time recent experience
requirements.detail: In the nominated ANZSCO occupation within the past 5 years

requirements.label: Completed skills assessment
requirements.detail: CAANZ, ACS, AMI, or Engineers Australia depending on occupation

requirements.label: Employer willing to nominate for 186
requirements.detail: Must hold current SBS and nominate directly for permanent residency

whatWeDo.heading: What RedBridge Does
whatWeDo.legalPartnerNote: Legal partner: Migration advice and visa lodgement are handled exclusively by Insight Idea, RedBridge's licensed legal partner (MARN: 1467870).

weDo.title: Verify every employer before presenting them
weDo.detail: Sponsorship approval status, genuine vacancy, and TSMIT salary compliance are all checked before any client introduction.

weDo.title: Give honest eligibility assessments
weDo.detail: At the free consultation, including telling you clearly if you don't yet qualify for a 482 application.

weDo.title: Work with a MARA-registered legal partner
weDo.detail: Insight Idea (MARN: 1467870) is based at the same Docklands address. No outsourced handoffs, no information gaps.

weDo.title: Structure fees across milestones
weDo.detail: You pay as outcomes are delivered, not as a single upfront sum before work has begun.

weDo.title: Plan your 186 PR from day one
weDo.detail: We map your 186 ENS transition from the moment your 482 is granted, not as a last-minute scramble.

weDont.title: Send unverified job lists
weDont.detail: Every employer introduction is personal and specific to your profile, not a spreadsheet of possibilities.

weDont.title: Guarantee visa outcomes
weDont.detail: No agency legally can. If one tells you otherwise, that is a red flag worth taking seriously.

weDont.title: Take your money if you don't qualify
weDont.detail: If your free assessment reveals the pathway isn't achievable, we say so before any fees are discussed.

weDont.title: Fabricate work experience
weDont.detail: False histories fail and can create serious legal consequences. Every record we produce is genuine and traceable.
